name: test-driver-signatures
description: A parameter of a function the Go test driver runs is fixed by the driver, so a test, a benchmark, an example, a fuzz test and TestMain that never read theirs are not reported, and none of them is reported as unreferenced. A test-file helper a test calls is judged like any function and its unread parameter is reported, and a test-file helper nothing calls is reported whole as an unreferenced declaration, so its unread parameter is not. A test file's init function and blank declaration are roots, as they are in production code, and neither is reported as unreferenced.
